div.span:
How a vote on a server list becomes a pending reward, and how the player claims it in game.
Scope: NuVotifier config and Arffornia_Proxy@1fcb8d0 (VoteListener, ApiService), Arffornia_Website (routes/api.php, VoteController, VoteService), Arffornia_Mods@a72e114 (RewardHandler, DatabaseManager) · derived from code, 2026-10-29
A shop purchase on the website writes the same pending_rewards row (ShopItemsService) and is claimed the same way. The router and the API hairpin are not drawn (view runtime).
v0.1 · source: architecture/arffornia/views/vote-and-reward.yaml
